changes: Owned bookmark toggle now appears on every library view — Cards, Table, Bookshelf, Series, Authors, Shelves, Owned, and Favourites
New dedicated Owned view and Favourites view in the library toolbar
Bulk edit — select multiple books and update status, rating, genre, tags, or delete in one action
Library scroll position is now preserved after editing a book — returns to exactly where you left off
Word count field added alongside page count — especially useful for ebooks (e.g. via Calibre)
Multiple re-read dates — record start date, finish date, and notes for every time you re-read a book
Drag-and-drop cover upload — drag an image from your computer or spreadsheet, or paste from clipboard (Ctrl+V)
Spine color reset button — restores the auto-extracted dominant cover color if you have changed it manually
Series completion — series auto-marks as Complete when all books are read, with manual override; filter by Ongoing First or Ongoing Only
Memory Check now scores against your own book notes — no internet connection required; the more detail you add, the richer the quiz
View Last Results button on Book Memory — review your most recent quiz without starting a new session
Search now ignores leading articles — searching 'Persian' finds 'The Persian'
Sort direction toggle — switch between ascending and descending order with the ↑/↓ button
Update notifications — a banner appears when a new version is available
Changelog — click the version number in Settings to see what changed in each version
Drag-to-reorder your library — switch to Sort: Manual Order in Cards, Table, or Bookshelf view
Custom shelves — create named shelves like 'Favourites', 'Summer Reads', 'Lent Out'
Find and remove duplicate books — Settings → Library & Data → Scan for Duplicates
Dominant Cover Color spine style — spines take on each book's most prominent cover colour
Add books to a series from the Series view without opening each book individually
Customisable dashboard layout — drag and resize every widget on the Home dashboard
Barcode scanner support — scan any book's ISBN barcode to auto-fill title, author, and cover
Six reading statuses — added Paused and Re-reading alongside existing statuses
Memory checks for every book you've started (not just finished books)
Tag and Audience Age filters — filter by Tag, Audience Age, Status, and Genre combined
Favourite from any view — heart icon on cards, table rows, and bookshelf spines
Favourites First sort option
Narrator field for audiobooks
Tags on journal entries
Genre is now a structured dropdown field
Edit entry date in the reading journal after saving
Date Started/Finished now correctly handled after Goodreads import
Fixed macOS installation files — resolves issues with the app not opening on Mac
Initial public launch
Book library with card, list, bookshelf, series and author views
Reading journal and quotes tracker
Book Memory with spaced repetition review system
Re-Read Radar for tracking books to revisit
Customisable accent colour and dark mode
